_comment: The first golden integration fixture. Utterances are in the exact shape the Doctor platform's TranscriptUtterance emits (doctor/types/transcript.ts): id, sequence, speaker, speakerLabel, text, startedAt, finalizedAt, status, confidence, provenance. An ACS presentation was chosen because it exercises every downstream stage - demographics, symptoms with duration and severity, past history, medication, a red flag, and investigation recommendations - and because its rule coverage is the strongest in diseases.yaml.

utterances.speaker: DOCTOR
utterances.text: Good morning. What brings you in today?

utterances.speaker: PATIENT
utterances.text: I am a 62 year old male. I have been having severe chest pain for two hours and I am sweating a lot.

utterances.speaker: PATIENT
utterances.text: I also feel short of breath and nauseous.

utterances.speaker: DOCTOR
utterances.text: Do you take any regular medication, and do you have any medical conditions?

utterances.speaker: PATIENT
utterances.text: I take aspirin daily and I have high blood pressure and diabetes.

utterances.speaker: PATIENT
utterances.text: I do not have any fever.
